content:
Field
Type
Description
src_ip
string
Source IP address. If the source is a Compute Engine
VM, src_ip is either the primary internal IP address
or an address in an alias IP range of the VM's network
interface. The external IP address is not shown.
Logging shows the IP address of the VM as the VM
sees it on the packet header, the same as if you ran
TCP dump on the VM.
Field
Type
Description
src_port
integer
Source port
dest_ip
string
Destination IP address. If the destination is a Google
Cloud VM, dest_ip is either the primary internal IP
address or an address in an alias IP range of the VM's
network interface. The external IP address is not
shown even if it was used in making the connection.
dest_port
integer
Destination port
protocol
integer
IP protocol
(https://www.iana.org/assignments/protocol-
numbers/protocol-numbers.xhtml)
of the connection
